title: Chart series data must stay unrounded; decimal places are applied only at display time
answers: metric card total or average is wrong with decimal places set
pie chart total sums rounded values
where should decimal places rounding happen for charts
body:
Invariant: the yData selector in dataVisualizationLogic.ts and parseBreakdownSeriesValue in Components/seriesBreakdownLogic.ts return raw numbers (only the percent x100 multiplier is applied). They must not round to formatting.decimalPlaces.
Why: the metric card total/average/change badge, pie totals and unaggregated breakdown buckets sum these values; rounding first makes totals wrong (two 0.49 rows must sum to 0.98).
Where rounding lives: tooltips, axis ticks, value labels, pie labels and the metric headline round via Components/Charts/sqlLineGraphAdapter.ts:formatSqlSeriesValue (explicit decimalPlaces, else 3 for unstyled), which delegates to formatDataWithSettings.
Also: yData maps unparseable values (e.g. 'NaN' string) to null, or 0 when showNullsAsZero is on, never NaN.
If parsers move (PR #105535 planned to move them into seriesValues.ts with the old rounding), drop the rounding there. Tests: dataVisualizationLogic.test.ts ([42.195,null,'NaN'] -> [42.195,0,0]) and seriesBreakdownLogic.test.ts guard this.
applies: SQL insight chart series parsing (y-axis and breakdown) in DataVisualization
